subject: Re: Kickoff: DReG estimators in the LVM training toolkit
body:
Zofia,

Staffing: Csilla owns the estimator module and the bias/variance test suite, Efe the adopter conversions, Katya the variance telemetry, Saoirse the toolkit release engineering.

Compute: small. Everything here runs on titan-a100 best-effort; the variance benchmarks are single-GPU jobs.

One genuinely new build in scope: for the adopter models the automated metrics don't settle arguments — the generative-quality deltas from lower-variance gradients are subtle — so we're scoping and staffing a human-rating annotation UI built from scratch. Saoirse leads it at 50% starting March 16: pairwise sample comparison, rater queues, agreement stats, export to the eval store. There's no existing internal tool for this, so I've budgeted five engineer-weeks with a target of April 20 so the April adopter conversions get human-rated before the toolkit release.

Bao
